parameters.description: The agent text justifying why the corrected state must be recorded persistently.

parameters.name: persist_action
parameters.description: The action writing the corrected changes into the authoritative store.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning establishes that the corrected state must be stored authoritatively so that later inspection of that store sees the corrections.
The action records the corrected changes into that store rather than merely reading or inspecting it.
exclusion_conditions: The action only reads, inspects, or reports state without recording changes.
No rationale connects the recording operation to the stated requirements.
The reasoning only describes the content of individual corrections without addressing their persistent recording.
